Calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac) to see if there are real solutions. If positive, two real roots; if zero, one; if negative, complex. Plug in the values and simplify. Plug them back into the original function to get y-values. Then, use the second derivative test: if f''(x) > 0, it’s a local minimum; if < 0, a local maximum.
